content: {"praised":["Acting, directing, cinematography are first‑rate.","The film studies Vietnam war effects realistically.","It is a powerful war/family drama.","It blends friendship, romance, horror, mystery.","It has strong thematic depth on war’s impact."],"criticized":["Wedding scenes are unnecessarily slow.","Russian roulette scenes are disturbing and overlong.","The film feels long and boring overall.","The hunting scene lasts too long.","Pacing is too slow throughout the movie."]}
